about_the_game:
Soar through the Skies, Command Your Ship, and Conquer the Bullet Storm!

Take the helm of a mighty steampunk airship in this fast-paced bullet hell shooter where the skies are your battlefield!

🔥 Blast Through 3 Unique Worlds

Navigate through beautifully hand-drawn steampunk-inspired landscapes, each filled with deadly foes and intense bullet patterns. Face off against three formidable bosses, each more challenging than the last!

⚙️ Upgrade, Customize, and Dominate

Gather loot and upgrade your ship with powerful weapons and abilities. Unlock devastating new firepower to turn the tide of battle!

🎮 Challenge Yourself at Your Own Pace

Adjust the difficulty to match your playstyle, from casual adventurer to bullet-dodging ace. Whether you crave a thrill or a test of pure skill, the skies await!

Do you have what it takes to defeat all three bosses and become the ultimate Captain of the Skies? 🚀⚔️

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD Graphics 520) or dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250)
